name: blind-review
description: Semantic code focus: Jev scores which regions of a file deserve human attention, everything else is faded by opacity.

blindreview.scriptPath.description: Path to review.py (the Jev scoring pipeline). Leave empty to use the one bundled next to this extension.

blindreview.python.description: Python interpreter used to run review.py.

blindreview.workers.description: Concurrent Jev calls (leaf judgments are independent).

blindreview.budget.description: Max Jev queries via branch-and-bound. Empty = score every leaf.

blindreview.contrast.description: Logit-space contrast stretch around the file baseline. 1.0 = raw probabilities; higher makes important regions pop harder and unimportant fade more.

blindreview.revealOnCursor.description: Un-fade the region under the cursor (hover equivalent).
